_nguon: CHT-1 — English templates for the 12 zodiac signs cluster (kb/trang_chiem_tinh.py, luangiai/cung_hoang_dao.py). Written by the editorial team.
trang_ct.gr.trong: in {k} years the Sun entered {sau} during that day (born before the switch time: {truoc}; after it: {sau})
trang_ct.gr.som: in {k} years the whole day was already {sau}
trang_ct.gr.muon: in {k} years the whole day was still {truoc}
trang_ct.tra_loi: {ten} is sign number {so} of the zodiac, for people born roughly {bd} to {kt}. The switch date drifts from year to year: between {a} and {b}, the Sun entered {ten} as early as {som} ({nam_som}) and as late as {muon} ({nam_muon}), Vietnam time. {ten} is a {nt} sign, of the {pc} group, ruled by {chu}. {tom}
trang_ct.td.ngay: {ten} dates: when does it start and end?
trang_ct.ngay: Your sign by birth date is the sign the Sun was passing through when you were born. The Sun enters {ten} at {do}° along the ecliptic and leaves it for {sau} at {do2}°. Because a calendar year is a little longer than 365 days and leap years step in, this moment drifts by a few hours, and in some years it lands on the neighbouring day. The table gives Vietnam clock time (UTC+7) for each year.
trang_ct.td.giap_ranh: Born on a cusp day: {ten} or {truoc}, {ten} or {sau}?
trang_ct.giap_ranh: If you were born on the day the sign changes, you need your birth time to be sure. Find your birth year in the table above: born before the listed time means the earlier sign, after it the later sign. Born before 1976? Use the date lookup on the 12 signs page: it uses the clock time of that era (in some periods, such as 1960–1975, clocks in southern Vietnam ran on UTC+8, one hour ahead of today).
trang_ct.chu2: Ruling planet: {chu} in the classical system; the modern system adds {hd}.
trang_ct.doi: Opposite sign: {doi} — the two sit at opposite ends of the zodiac and look at the same matters from two sides.
trang_ct.dong: Easy rapport: {ds} — same element or a supporting element, so the pace feels familiar.
trang_ct.va: More friction: {ds} — same {pc} group but a different element, so more agreeing is needed; this does not mean a poor match.
trang_ct.doi_yeu: The opposite sign, {doi}: often drawn to each other because each has what the other lacks, and often pulling in different directions — it works when both are willing to learn the other's way.
trang_ct.td.mot_phan: {ten} is only one part of a birth chart
trang_ct.mot_phan: Your sign by birth date only describes the Sun — what you are reaching for. Two {ten} people can still be very different because the Moon (emotional needs), the Ascendant (how others first see you) and the other planets sit in other signs. For the full picture, draw a birth chart from your date, time and place of birth.
trang_ct.hd.ngay_dap: Roughly {bd} to {kt}. The exact moment shifts by a few hours each year; if you were born on a switch day you need your birth time and the year-by-year table on this page.
trang_ct.hd.hop: Which signs does {ten} get along with?
trang_ct.hd.hop_dap: In the common reading, {ten} finds easy rapport with {ds}. This is a hint about temperament, not a compatibility score; two people still need to talk and agree.
trang_ct.hd.chu: What is the ruling planet of {ten}?
trang_ct.hd.chu_dap2: {chu} in the classical system, {hd} in the modern system.
trang_ct.mo_ta: {ten} ({bd}–{kt}): the time the Sun enters the sign each year {a}–{b}, which sign a cusp birthday belongs to, personality, love and work.
trang_ct.nguon1: Hieuban editorial team — the Sun sign in Western astrology, in its common reading
trang_ct.nguon2: Sign change times: Hieuban deterministic ephemeris, converted to Vietnam clock time
cung_hd.bang.tra_loi: The twelve zodiac signs split the Sun's yearly path into 12 parts of 30° each. In {nam}, the Sun enters {ten0} (the first sign) on {bd} Vietnam time; each sign lasts about 29–32 days and the switch date drifts a little from year to year, so a birthday on a cusp needs a birth time.
cung_hd.tra.mot: Born {d}: {ten}. That time, the Sun was in {ten} from {bd} to {kt} (clock time {utc}).
cung_hd.tra.giap: {d} is a cusp day: the Sun moves into {sau} at {moc} (clock time {utc}). Born before then: {truoc}; from then on: {sau}. Add your birth time to be sure.
cung_hd.tra.gio: Born {gio} on {d}: {ten}. That day the Sun moved into {sau} at {moc} (clock time {utc}).
cung_hd.tra.sat: Your birth time is less than 5 minutes from the switch — draw a full birth chart with time and place to double-check.
